::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 1st 1874  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell/6
:::

My dear Madam
Pray thank [Mrs Codrington](people/person_2294.qmd)[^1] very much for her kind present of [Mota](organizations/other_150.qmd) photographs   I did not possess any of them before, though I have some of Norfolk island and Florida<sup>2</sup>

yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: This present was no doubt given in connection with CMY's work on the *Life of John Coleridge Patteson*, with whom these places were associated.  Mrs Codrington was probably a relation (perhaps the mother) of the Rev. Robert Henry Codrington (1830-1922), who succeeded Bishop Patteson as head of the Melanesian mission in 1871.
